name: scholarsync
description: Convenience scripts for the JavaScript apps, plus observability and evaluation entrypoints. The Python hub is run with `python run.py`; see readme.md.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix expert-chat install && npm --prefix expert-chat-ui install && npm --prefix interview-ui install
scripts.dev:chat: concurrently "npm --prefix expert-chat run dev" "npm --prefix expert-chat-ui start"
scripts.build:ui: npm --prefix interview-ui run build && npm --prefix expert-chat-ui run build
scripts.obs:status: docker compose exec -T hub python -m observability.status
scripts.eval: docker compose exec -T hub python -m evaluation.runner
scripts.eval:agent: docker compose exec -T hub python -m evaluation.runner --agent
scripts.eval:rag: docker compose exec -T hub python -m evaluation.runner --rag
scripts.eval:report: docker compose exec -T hub python -m evaluation.runner --json reports/eval-report.json
